title: T2 MacBook keyboard, trackpad and Touch Bar

clauses.text: the keyboard types and the trackpad moves the pointer on the T2 Mac

steps.do: Type in a text field, then move one finger on the trackpad and try a tap and a two-finger scroll.
steps.expect: Keys are typed and the pointer moves. Report what the tap and the two-finger scroll do, since they were not tried before.

clauses.text: the Touch Bar shows its keys after the boot

steps.do: After the computer has booted, look at the Touch Bar strip.
steps.expect: The strip shows keys. If it stays blank, restart once: the Touch Bar sometimes configures only on a later try.

steps.do: Tap a key on the strip.
steps.expect: The key acts on the tap, and the keyboard backlight is checked as well.
